fields.validation_summary: Review finding on 2026-05-22: this ticket is not review-ready because the manifest still lacks acceptance_criteria, spec_refs, implementation_summary, and recorded validation; the description describes additive shader and transform work but the ticket graph does not encode downstream or supporting links; and there is no context-editor spec traceability attached to the work. Required follow-up: promote the Phase 1a acceptance criteria into ticket fields, attach the relevant dependency/spec linkage, and record focused validation before returning to review. Minimum expected validation: cargo check --manifest-path context-stack/tools/context-editor/kernel/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown, cargo check --manifest-path context-stack/tools/context-editor/sandbox-app/Cargo.toml, and targeted verification for SvoTransform uniform upload plus WGSL bit-decode helper correctness.
